ION had regular monthly calls with the DOE/NETL program manager to provide status updates. ION Clean Energy 5 DE-FE0031950: FINAL PROJECT REPORT 3 Project Summary 3.1 Statement of Project Objectives The overall objective of this project was to empirically demonstrate the low capital and operating costs of ION’s transformational ICE-31® solvent, featuring revolutionary stability technology, on a 1 MWe slipstream flue gas from Calpine’s LMEC, a commercially dispatched NGCC power plant. To accomplish this, the project team designed, constructed, and operated an engineering-scale CO capture pilot system that captured 10 tpd. This project served as a vital step in piloting an ION- 2 optimized design plant with actual NGCC flue gas prior to design, engineering, and construction of a commercial-scale CO capture plant. 2 This project utilized a modular design and fabrication approach to deliver the engineering-scale system and was designed to yield a CO product flow with >95% purity that was suitable for 2 compression and dehydration into a CO pipeline. The CO capture process was optimized to take 2 2 full advantage of the benefits provided by the 3rd generation ICE-31® solvent in combination with other process improvements, all of which were derived through a process-intensification design philosophy focused on NGCC flue gas. The benefits of this holistic approach included a smaller physical plant, reduced energy requirements, improved CO product quality, less solvent 2 degradation, lower emissions, lower water usage, less maintenance, and lower capital costs. Work for this project was completed in three budget periods. BP1, the design phase, was completed as of September 15, 2021. Goals for BP1 included Process Design Basis, Process Design Package, Cost Estimate, Balance of Plant Design Package, Subcontractor Selection, and Permitting. BP2, the construction phase was completed as of September 15, 2023. Goals for BP2 included the balance of plant host site preparation, modular plant fabrication, installation, and commissioning. In BP3, the testing phase was completed on February 28, 2025.
